name: VOIDWRIGHT
description: Build ships, rovers and stations block by block in an open universe: home worlds, then generated planet groups, stars that light and burn, a ringed gas giant, comets and nebulae. Land anywhere, explore caves, dig through planets and asteroids, drive on wheels and tracks. 101 blocks with guns, rockets, turrets and working gravity generators; 21 designs from buggies to huge stations, with previews. Pirates come to rob you; crashed ships wait to be repaired. Creative mode, or survival: mine, refine, assemble and weld every block up from a frame.
